shadow.note: in-worker shadow compare: for every vectorized group at every hooked layer the legacy per-row path ran on a clone of the same rows and the two outputs were compared exactly (torch.equal); the per-row result was served. Unequal groups record the deviation: max_abs_diff; max_ulps = the largest |diff| in ulps of the per-row result's dtype at that element's own magnitude (nonzero references; inflates where the edit cancels the activation); max_ulps_edit = the largest excess of |stacked edit - per-row edit| over one bf16 rounding of the output, in bf16 ulps of the per-row edit (lens_adapters.edit_excess_ulps — the gate's per-element unit; kernel variance <= ~1, a dropped / halved / misplaced edit far more wherever the edit exceeds a couple of output ulps); max_frac_row / max_frac_group = the largest fraction of unequal elements in any one row / any one group (the concentration bounds that catch a whole row's edit dropped where it is within one output ulp); max_abs_ref = the largest |per-row value| in an unequal group; n_unequal_elems / n_elems_compared = elements that differed / elements in every counted comparison. The CONTRACT is applied by the gate (scripts/lens_vectorize_gate.py): exact for elementwise ops and under the per-row mode; a bounded bf16-kernel-variance tolerance for reduction ops under the stacked mode. Gate-only (SISTEER_LENS_SHADOW_COMPARE=1); inert when off
